data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 碧海晴空的浅滩涉水
data.description: 碧空如洗的人工海滩浅水区，透明的浅蓝浪花轻快拍打着脚踝。雪菜双手紧紧抱着白粉相间的圆形游泳圈，被突如其来的小海浪冲得身子微晃。她脚下一滑轻呼出声，水花溅湿了纯白比基尼与发梢。抬头望向身旁伸手扶住她的前辈，少女双颊鼓起微红，既惊魂未定又带着被逗笑的娇嗔。
data.location: 清澈透明的热带海滨浅水滩
data.action: 双手抱游泳圈在浅水中涉浪微倾，微抬脸颊被浪逗笑轻嗔
data.lighting: 水面折射出的粼粼水波焦散光与明媚阳光
data.camera: 全身微仰景，浪花飞溅与碧海蓝天尽收眼底
data.promptProse: Wading through crystal-clear shallow ocean waves under bright azure skies, Yukina clutches a pastel striped swim ring with both hands. A playful crest of sea foam splashes against her ankles, causing her to stagger cutely with a surprised gasp. Her pure white frilled bikini glistens in the dazzling sun caustics as she pouts playfully, looking upward with wet hair and a charming rosy blush.
data.animaCaption: Wading in the shallow ocean waves with a swim ring, pouting adorably in her white bikini under the summer sun.
